sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
This Request for Tender (RFT) is for the supply of Protective and Uniform Footwear for the New South Wales Rural Fire Service (NSW RFS or RFS).The NSW RFS requires footwear solutions that provide operational safety, durability, ergonomic support, comfort, and compliance with applicable Australian and International Standards across a wide range of operational and corporate environments.
The NSW RFS uses the Coupa system to manage all sourcing events. Please use the link below to access the complete tender documentation and submit your response.
